earnings.title: ADP Reports First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results
highlights: Revenues increased 6% compared to last year's first quarter to $5.5 billion; 6% organic constant currency
Diluted earnings per share ("EPS") increased 14% to $2.83; adjusted diluted EPS increased 13% to $2.82
Diluted EPS increased 14% to $2.83, and adjusted diluted EPS increased 13% to $2.82.
Compared to last year’s first quarter, revenues increased 6% to $5.5 billion and 6% on an organic constant currency basis.
Employer Services revenues increased 6% on a reported basis and 6% on an organic constant currency basis

quotes.text: ADP is off to a strong start in fiscal 2027 with first quarter results that reflect the resilience of our business model and the trust our clients continue to place in us.
quotes.by: Maria Black, President and Chief Executive Officer, ADP

quotes.text: Our first quarter results exceeded our expectations across revenue growth, adjusted EBIT margin expansion, and adjusted EPS growth.
quotes.by: Peter Hadley, Chief Financial Officer, ADP

outlook: A combination of various forward yield curves that reflect our investment mix, resulting in a blended rate of 5.3%, was used to forecast new purchase rates across the client and corporate extended and client long portfolios over the remainder of the fiscal year.
